title: Establish nominal nonexplosion and nonreversible L2 contraction

Its stationary mean holding time is1/sum pi q>0, so ergodic holding-time sums diverge almost surely; positivity/irreducibility extends nonexplosion from that invariant jump law to every state. Stationary occupation law is exactly pi and unique; singleton classes are trivial. Stationary variance dissipation with the proved Poincare inequality yields exponential L2 contraction without reversibility. Independent coefficient errors break circulation in general; no perturbed recurrence or robust stationary approximation is claimed.
